# buddy_rulesets (Data Source)

List rulesets of a project and optionally filter them by identifier. Only workspace administrators and project managers can read rulesets

Token scope required: `RULESET_READ`

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "buddy_rulesets" "all" {
  domain       = "mydomain"
  project_name = "myproject"
}

data "buddy_rulesets" "protect" {
  domain           = "mydomain"
  project_name     = "myproject"
  identifier_regex = "^protect-"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `domain` (String) The workspace's URL handle
- `project_name` (String) The project's name

### Optional

- `identifier_regex` (String) The ruleset's identifier regular expression to match

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The Terraform resource identifier for this item
- `rulesets` (Attributes Set) List of rulesets (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--rulesets))

<a id="nestedatt--rulesets"></a>
### Nested Schema for `rulesets`

Read-Only:

- `disabled` (Boolean)
- `html_url` (String)
- `identifier` (String)
- `name` (String)
- `refs` (Set of String)
- `ruleset_id` (String)
